The ESP32-DevKitM-1 evaluation board by Espressif Systems is a development platform designed for wireless applications. Built around the ESP32-MINI-1 module, it features an Xtensa® dual-core 32-bit LX6 microprocessor running up to 240 MHz, offering processing power for complex tasks. The board supports 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi and Bluetooth® Smart Ready 4.x (BLE) connectivity at 2.4GHz, making it ideal for IoT and wireless communication projects. It comes with 4MB flash and offers 28 GPIOs with a rich set of peripherals, including USB, I2C, SPI, and PWM. Most I/O pins are broken out to pin headers for easy interfacing with external hardware. The PCB antenna ensures reliable wireless performance. This comprehensive development board is perfect for prototyping, testing, and developing wireless solutions.
